sources.title: A new and most complete pampathere from Quaternary Bahia
sources.author: Moura et al.2019
sources.evidence: Author fulltext read and Fig1 LPP-PV-001 skeleton300mm scale viewed. H.septentrionalis AMNH23435 reported three movable bands. H.cryptae skeleton2.2m axial length only comparative, not main species size.

sources.title: Osteoderm morphology and taxonomy of Pampatheriidae
sources.author: Ferreira et al.2025
sources.evidence: Three mobile rows delimited by two semimovable rows; H.cryptae osteoderms equivalent to Pampatherium and further cranial study recommended. Not a confirmed new combination.
